patches.purpose: Typed callback bridges for supported Q8/F16/BF16/F32 tensor paths; no arithmetic changes
WASM SIMD Q8_0/Q8_1 activation quantization rounds to nearest like the reference and x86 paths instead of truncating; browser WASM CPU arithmetic only
nlohmann::json destruction falls back to recursion instead of terminating when its flattening stack cannot be allocated; no arithmetic changes
JSON parsing and Jinja rendering propagate std::bad_alloc instead of rewrapping or swallowing it; no arithmetic changes
ggml checks unchecked internal allocations: the CPU thread pool reports GGML_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED, graph allocator/scheduler sites abort instead of dereferencing NULL; no arithmetic changes
Special-token partitioning keeps the previous list element instead of walking from the start for every match: linear instead of quadratic time, identical tokens; no arithmetic changes
A failed CPU work-buffer allocation leaves no freed buffer behind and reports GGML_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED instead of throwing; no arithmetic changes
A failed CPU worker thread creation joins the threads already started and reports GGML_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED instead of aborting the process; no arithmetic changes
An embeddings context whose graph has no logits tensor reserves no n_vocab x outputs logits buffer (backport of upstream ed019cd8b without its header change); no arithmetic changes

The ModernBERT decision graph evaluates only the head of a question type the library selects (thread-local, not exported) and repeats its scores in all three columns; bit-identical scores, default evaluates every type as upstream

Tokenization counts its work over the whole call and calls a thread-local stop check the library swaps in and out (not exported) once per 1024 units; a stop, a failed allocation or another exception returns a distinct value from llama_tokenize instead of throwing through the C API; identical tokens when not stopped, no arithmetic changes
ggml_cpu_init allocates and frees a ggml context to initialize ggml's timer only until that happened once, instead of on every graph computation; no arithmetic changes

WebGPU buffer and backend creation capture device errors in error scopes and fail the allocation (NULL buffer or backend) instead of aborting through the uncaptured-error callback; WebGPU builds only; no arithmetic changes
llama_encode returns -2 for a failed allocation and -3 for any other exception instead of throwing through the C API (undefined behaviour with clang-cl /EHsc); no arithmetic changes

No C++ exception leaves the llama.cpp, ggml and GGUF C functions the library reaches: model loading, GGUF reading (freeing what it read), buffer and CPU backend creation return NULL on a failed allocation, model loading checks its dummy buffers and fails when the CPU extra buffer types cannot be listed, graph reservation and allocation return false when the split fails, logging truncates instead of throwing, and the one-time registry and CPU device records abort like ggml's other small allocations (undefined behaviour with clang-cl /EHsc otherwise); no arithmetic changes
